candidates.title: [Bug] DeepSeek-V4 sparse MLA can index past block-table rows during CUDA-graph warmup
candidates.snippet: ### Summary  We found a distinct DeepSeek-V4 sparse-MLA metadata bug where CUDA-graph warmup can produce a request index that is outside the number of rows in the block table. The downstream Triton mapper does not bound `req_idx`, so the same bad metadata can become either a silent wrong KV-slot mapping or, at full serving geometry, a CUDA illegal memory access that kills all TP ranks. candidates.title: [Bug] DeepSeek V4 sparse MLA can index a nonexistent block-table row during CUDA-graph warmup
candidates.snippet: ### Summary  I found a separate DeepSeek-V4 sparse-MLA bounds bug while debugging a TP=2 CUDA illegal-address failure.  During CUDA-graph warmup, `CommonAttentionMetadata.token_to_req_indices()` can generate a request index that has no corresponding row in `block_table`. The downstream Triton mapper, `_compute_global_topk_indices_and_lens_kernel`, trusts `req_idx` and performs a block-table gather without checking `req_idx < block_table.shape[0]`.
